instruction.task: Implement Phase 1, Slice 5 of the Agency Command Center ERP.
instruction.objective: Replace dashboard stubs with derived tenant-safe dashboard APIs and operational dashboard UI.

section.title: 1. Dashboard Aggregation APIs
section.requirement: Implement GET /api/dashboard/summary deriving Active Clients, Active Workflows, Average Completion Percentage, Open Blockers, and Team Utilization placeholder if source data is insufficient.
Implement GET /api/dashboard/client-health deriving health status from workflow completion: on_track, at_risk, off_track.
Implement GET /api/dashboard/upcoming-deadlines for incomplete tasks due within 7 days and overdue tasks.
Implement GET /api/dashboard/open-blockers sorted by severity then flagged_at.
Implement recent activity feed from append-only activity_logs, limited to last 20 records.

section.title: 2. Dashboard UI Completion
section.requirement: Connect metric cards to dashboard APIs and remove hard-coded production-looking stubs.
Show client, current workflow/month, progress, health badge, and blocker count.
Show upcoming and overdue task deadlines with visual urgency.
Show open blockers with severity badges and client/task context.
Clicking client or workflow rows navigates to relevant detail screens.

logic.description: Dashboard data must be derived from clients, workflows, tasks, blockers, and activity logs. Do not create dashboard source-of-truth tables.
No cross-tenant aggregate query is allowed.
Realtime/websocket behavior is not active in Phase 1. Use TanStack Query invalidation/refetch.

item.req: Load within Phase 1 targets for 50 active clients

instruction.first_principles_check: The dashboard observes operational truth. It must not become operational truth.
